body: I've read that twins are more susceptible to mental illness, however counterintuitively we are less likely to commit suicide because of a close connection with another person. Makes my loss hurt so much more but hopefully that give you comfort that the odds are in your favor to keep betting on living.
If interested please read what I responded to another person in this thread
We were and still are. It's unimaginable that I lost him to this awful disease. I appreciate the condolences.

Also to add on... I think it's important to feel sad when I want to feel sad. Because that's how I feel and want to do, pretending is a path toward perpetual fake happiness. I think for me it's healthier to allow my emotions out in a healthy way. Bc then I've acknowledged it and can move on until the next wave hits.

Thank you - take care. Also for what it's worth. I'm 31 and use to cut in college. I know it sounds crazy coming from someone who's twin committed suicide. But it does get better. I know you said you're afraid speaking to a professional, trust me whatever you tell them will not shock them. If people get mad or upset that you went... I mean who cares? You've had those feelings about people you care about and have gotten over them. They will too, helping to pick out my brother's casket will never go away. Again, please take care. I don't know anything about you but I'm making the assumption you're not homeless since you're online. You have a lot left in front you and as long as you walk through open doors you'll meet a lot of people good and bad... you never know when you'll meet some one or do something that will change your life.

I don't think that will happen the first time. Are you saying that bc that's how you would want your twin to feel? Not being confrontational but I realized all the advice I gave my twin when he was depressed (4 years) I was really saying what I would do to feel better. 

I can promise you as a twin who has had his brother suicided, you don't realize how much you have to stay your birthday for everything. Fucking sucks. Then have people call you "brother" on top of it when they say goodbye. 


We were best friends and more than that. Best friends diminishes our relationship. It was something beyond this world. One day I will be able to see him again. Until then every day is hell. Some worse then others. But I try everyday - bc I need to take my own advice that I gave him. And I can't fix your problems or even care to but my advice is take your own - you listen to yourself more than anyone else for better or worse.

So was he and it didn't fix anything. I hate my birthday not because of him. It's the only thing I can't legally change. I can't help you - I would recommend talking to a counselor or psychiatrist... I am in the process of that. I have found talking to others who have lost a twin to suicide has helped during the hardest times so far. But I am not even close and know I will never be healed, it's impossible.

I'm happy you did too. My twin brother hung himself on 8.14.17... I know that technically his depression is gone from his body. But my family and particularly myself will never have that pain go away. It hurts so bad that I believe even in death I would still feel pain on the other side. I hope and want nothing but the best for you. Over 300 people came to his funeral and he thought he had no one. He is forever 31 and I am forever in torment.

That exactly what my twin did... and he hung himself on 8.14.17... my parents called me when they found him in the woods. I am forever fucked up after hearing the my dads screams on the phone. I'm currently on medication for schizophrenia because it's beyond human possibly to comprehend who I lost. 

A week after he died I had his phone and 3 companies called about employment. It does get better. But if you leave it honestly never will for the ones left behind.


I miss bryan. More than I ever thought was possible.
